contexts.text: Silver = spiritual truth.
For iron silver = for natural truth spiritual truth.
Spiritual truths and celestial goods (alone remain with angelic Spirits).
Intellectual or spiritual truth. AC 2507.
See Celestial Truth. AC 5897:9.
Sarah his wife = spiritual truth conjoined with the Celestial. AC 2517.
That they would have no respect for spiritual truth in that state. Signified, Explained. AC 2554, Explained.
That the Rational is from celestial good as a father, but not from spiritual truth as a mother. Signified, Explained.

For if spiritual truth were to inflow from the interior, as good does, man would be born into the whole Rational and Scientific. (Thus man in his present state) would adulterate and falsify the truths which flowed in.
That spiritual truth has been conjoined with the Celestial by means of rationality. Signified, Explained.
That the Lord alone had perception from spiritual truth. Signified, Explained.
As He implanted rational truth in rational good, so He implanted spiritual truth in celestial good...
Rational truths are as clothing to spiritual truths.
That spiritual truth might be conjoined with celestial good. Signified, Explained.
Whether you say spiritual truth and celestial good, or the Lord, it is the same. Explained.
That He should act according to spiritual truth. Signified, Explained.
The boy (Ishmael) = spiritual truth.
To go away from the boy = removal from spiritual truth.
Arrows = spiritual truths.
Waters = truths spiritual, rational, and scientific.
Wine = spiritual truth.
Still less is man born into any spiritual truth: as, that there is a God...
With men, spiritual truths are at first scientifics; for when doctrinal things are being learned... they are nothing else...
The rams of Nebaioth = spiritual truth.
The princes of Kedar = spiritual truths.
This is the case also with spiritual truths, which are called doctrinals, and are still more interior commandments; for doctrinals are the interior truths which belong to the natural man. Explained.
Meal put into the pottage = that heap of scientifics amended by spiritual truth from the Word.
Ephraim = spiritual truth (in the Natural. AC 5351:4.)
Rational things, or, what is the same, appearances of truth, that is, spiritual truths, are not Knowledges, but are in them; for they are of the internal man.
That spiritual truth is received at first because it is called Divine; afterwards, because what is Divine is in it. Treated of.
It is celestial good and spiritual truth from the Lord which form man, and then impart the power to receive each of them successively...
Under Dew, see this reference. AC 3579:5. AE 278:5.
The truths of the Church, which are called spiritual truths. Signified.
For natural light presents to view nothing of spiritual truth without the influx of the light of Heaven.
Into natural good spiritual truths cannot inflow on account of the natural appearances and fallacies of the senses.
The hollow of the thigh = ... where is the influx of spiritual truth into natural good.
Spiritual truth (as distinguished from celestial truth) is the truth which is of doctrine.
The land of Benjamin = the spiritual truth which is of the Church.
Spiritual truth from the Celestial is here treated of.
Divine spiritual truths are the things which are of the derivative faith.
That truth not spiritual applied itself to the ultimate of spiritual truth. Signified, Explained.
A turning away from spiritual truth. Signified, Explained.
Conjunction of spiritual truth with its good. Signified.
Cup = spiritual truth, that is, the truth of faith which is from the good of charity; the like as wine.
Silk = spiritual truths.
Wanted spiritual truths to be equally procured through scientifics. Signified.
That, in order to live, they should procure for themselves the good of spiritual truth. Signified.
Life from spiritual truth. Signified.
That spiritual truth may receive you graciously. Signified.
That the celestial internal man infilled the medium with spiritual truth from itself. Treated of. The spiritual truth which is with it, is the silver cup of Joseph.
The interior or spiritual truth which proceeds from the celestial Internal is the truth of good.
The sons of Israeli spiritual truths in the Natural. AC 5951, Explained.
When men are affected with the truths of faith, and live according to them, they then become spiritual truths.
That truths which are spiritual promoted natural truth. Signified, Explained.
For when celestial love (Judah) inflows into the spiritual truths which are represented by the sons of Israel, it disposes them into order. Explained.
Zebulon, here, = those in the Church who conclude about spiritual truths from scientifics, and thus strengthen them with themselves. AC 6384:end.
Spiritual truths are from the Celestial Internal, but through spiritual good. Signified.
Spiritual truths in the Natural, and the innocence which is in them, which should live through the Internal from Divine truth and good. Signified, Explained.
Cedar wood = internal spiritual truth; hyssop, external.
Bought with silver = who has some spiritual truth.
Dance is predicated of the affection of spiritual truth.

Wings = spiritual truths... because everything intellectual is from them... For the Intellectual sees from the light of Heaven, which is spiritual truth; that is, the truth of faith... Wings also = the powers which are of spiritual truth from its good.
Man-servant = the affection of spiritual truth.
If the affection of truth from natural delight does not accord with spiritual truth. Signified, Explained.
The Natural is then subordinate to spiritual truth. Signified, Explained.
Natural affection conjoined with spiritual truth constantly requires the sustaining of its life from the spiritual truth with which it has been conjoined. Signified, Explained.
Something of elevation is involved, here, of spiritual truth to accordance with scientific truth.

It here treats of those who, from some spiritual truth regard some scientific truth and, because no accordance appears, therefore the spiritual truth is weakened and for some time separated; but is not denied or exterminated. AC 9032. Example AC 9033.
The indemnification of the spiritual truth which has been weakened through scientific truth. Signified.

That truth is called spiritual truth, which, together with good, makes the life of the internal man... This truth is from the internal sense of the Word; thus also from the genuine doctrine of faith of the Church.
That the restoration of spiritual truth is effected by a right interpretation of scientific truth, or of the literal sense of the Word. Signified.
It now treats of the weakening of scientific truth, which is that of the literal sense, by spiritual truth, which is that of the doctrine of faith.
How the truth of the literal sense serves for the formation of spiritual truths. Explained. AC 9034:4.

The truths which are thus conjoined (with good) in the internal man are called spiritual truths; and the good with which the truths have been conjoined is called spiritual good. This good, formed through the truths, is what makes the spiritual life of man. The truths themselves there, are called truths of faith; and the good, the good of charity. The good into which truths have been thus implanted is the Church with man.
If they should have injured or extinguished anything of the power of spiritual truth. Signified, Explained.
Spiritual perception does not come forth from natural truths, but from spiritual truths. Spiritual truths are those which are called truths of faith.
For all spiritual truths are stored up in scientifics, as in their vessels.
Flax = spiritual truth; wool, celestial truth.
Onyx stones = truths of faith which are from love, or spiritual truths.
As the Intellectual of the spiritual man is signified by fine twined linen spiritual truth is also signified by it.
They have not defiled their garments = spiritual truths, which are truths from good.
The truths of the Spiritual Kingdom are those which are called spiritual truths, which are in the intellectual part. These are signified by robes. Illustrated.
To deprive of their spiritual truths those who live in simple good. Signified.
Spiritual truth sufficient for conjunction. Signified, Explained.
(Anoint) the candlestick and its vessels = in spiritual truth, which is of the Second Heaven, and in the ministering truths.
This worship is effected through spiritual truths...
Spiritual truths cannot be comprehended unless the following five universals are known. Enumerated. NJHD 34.
Men are dull and stupid as to spiritual truths, in proportion as they indulge the sense of taste and the blandishments of the touch.
Truths are of three kinds: civil, moral, and spiritual... Spiritual truths relate to the things of Heaven and the Church; in general, to the good which is of love and the truth which is of faith.
The Rational is opened... to the third degree, through spiritual truths.
All spiritual truths regard charity as their beginning, and end.
Spiritual truths are the petals of these flowers.
Having harps = confession of the Lord's Divine Human from spiritual truths. AE 323.
That there is no longer any spiritual truth, or natural truth, serving for doctrine and life, from the Word with them. Signified, Explained. AE 527.
(Their reasonings) fall to nothing by virtue of the spiritual truths rationally understood, which the Michaels of the New Church adduce. Signified, Explained.
Spiritual truths are of faith from charity.
Rational truths are those which proximately receive spiritual truths; for the Rational of man is the first receptacle of spiritual truths...
Natural Truths relatively to spiritual and celestial truths. Explained.
The English have an interior light, which is such that they receive spiritual truth more quickly than others...
The wings of a dove covered with silver = spiritual truths.
I have expanded My wing over thee = spiritual truth through which reformation has been effected.
(Evil) is removed so as not to appear, through spiritual truths, which are truths from good. Signified.
Congregations = those in spiritual truths, and, abstractedly, these truths themselves.
Spiritual truth is the truth of faith from the good of charity.
That He will endow them with spiritual truths. Signified.
Truths from good, are what are called spiritual truths.
The left = spiritual truth, which is truth in shade.
All spiritual truths are from the Word, and make a one with the good of love and of charity.
In the light of Heaven, spiritual truths appear as clearly as...
5. a. Spiritual truths (as distinguished from moral and civil ones) are those which the Word teaches about God. Enumerated.
